" TilluAnnaDJPedithe " is a vibrant and high-energy Telugu video song from the movie "." Starring Siddhu and Neha Shetty, this party anthem is composed by Ram Miriyala, who also lends his voice to the track. With pulsating beats and catchy lyrics, this song is bound to get you grooving on the dance floor.
